top_signal.title: Grafana Turns Cypress Test Results Into Persistent Observability Data
top_signal.summary: Grafana Labs published a pattern to export Cypress lifecycle data to Prometheus (via Pushgateway) and ingest it into Grafana Cloud, creating time-series metrics for individual tests, specs, durations, failure rates and flaky frequency across runs.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Makes test reliability and performance observable alongside app telemetry, enabling trend detection, flaky-test triage, and alerting for suite degradation rather than relying on ephemeral CI logs.

items.title: Measuring the back/forward cache with Application Metrics
items.summary: Sentry released bfcacheMetricsIntegration (JS SDK v11) to model bfcache hits, misses, reasons and reload cost as application metrics so teams can chart back/forward cache health and investigate regressions by route.
items.why_it_matters: Closes a visibility gap: QA can detect regressions that standard performance tools miss, prioritize fixes by route/release, and quantify user impact of bfcache misses.

items.title: Professional skepticism is a dev’s best skill
items.summary: Stack Overflow’s post/interview with BrowserStack’s David Burns argues for professional skepticism when using AI/agents, recommends applying TDD principles to agentic workflows, and focuses flaky-test fixes on controlling application state and isolation.
items.why_it_matters: Reinforces disciplined test design and skepticism for teams using agents; practical guidance to reduce flaky tests and validate agent-produced test assets or fixes.

items.title: Agentic autofix now uses Copilot Memory
items.summary: GitHub updated its agentic autofix so, when enabled, autofix agents consult Copilot Memory for contextual clues before proposing fixes — surfacing prior recommendations or repo-specific context into automated remediation.
items.why_it_matters: Autofix behavior now depends on persisted memory; QA must validate agent-applied patches, add tests guarding autofix changes, and audit memory-influenced fixes to prevent regressions or nondeterministic outcomes.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.1 adds C/C++ queries and Kotlin 2.4.20 support
items.summary: GitHub released CodeQL 2.27.1 with new queries for C and C++, Kotlin 2.4.20 support, and query-accuracy improvements to code scanning and analysis pipelines.
items.why_it_matters: Expands static-analysis coverage for native and Kotlin code; QA teams should upgrade scanners, revise rulesets, and retune suppression to reduce false positives and coverage gaps.

items.title: Build your way: Use any AI agent of your choice in Android Studio
items.summary: Android Studio added first-class support for third-party AI agents (agent mode) with access to build diagnostics, emulators, SDK tools and test execution, enabling agents to run, diagnose, and triage mobile tests inside the IDE.
items.why_it_matters: Enables agentic test design and local triage for mobile teams; QA must validate agent sandboxing, ensure reproducible runs, and add audit trails for agent-driven test actions.
